note: One sound library out of three sources: earshot's synthesized bank (MIT), uisfx's interface sounds (CC0 audio), and Openverse's real recordings (per-item licence). Every sound carries its own licence and its measured shape.

kindVocabulary.label: confirm
kindVocabulary.about: accepted, done, successful — the good ending

kindVocabulary.label: notify
kindVocabulary.about: an alert, a message, attention

kindVocabulary.label: close
kindVocabulary.about: something closing, dismissing, going away

kindVocabulary.label: pick
kindVocabulary.about: choosing, selecting, marking something

kindVocabulary.label: progress
kindVocabulary.about: work in progress — loading, processing, streaming

kindVocabulary.label: drag
kindVocabulary.about: a drag, a scrub, something being moved by hand

kindVocabulary.label: open
kindVocabulary.about: something opening, expanding, going in

kindVocabulary.label: error
kindVocabulary.about: rejected, invalid, blocked — the bad ending

kindVocabulary.label: media
kindVocabulary.about: playing, seeking, recording — the transport

kindVocabulary.label: click
kindVocabulary.about: a tick or a press — a button, a switch, a short contact

kindVocabulary.label: start
kindVocabulary.about: starting, playing, going

kindVocabulary.label: toggle
kindVocabulary.about: a state change — something switched on or off

kindVocabulary.label: type
kindVocabulary.about: typing, keys, keystrokes

kindVocabulary.label: impact
kindVocabulary.about: a heavy hit, with weight behind it

kindVocabulary.label: stop
kindVocabulary.about: stopping, pausing, ending

kindVocabulary.label: whoosh
kindVocabulary.about: a fast move through air — a whip pan, a fly-in

kindVocabulary.label: pop
kindVocabulary.about: a short bright pop — round, quick, playful

kindVocabulary.label: glitch
kindVocabulary.about: a digital break — wrong, broken, too fast

kindVocabulary.label: riser
kindVocabulary.about: a build that goes somewhere

kindVocabulary.label: undo
kindVocabulary.about: taking something back

kindVocabulary.label: drop
kindVocabulary.about: a descending move, usually low

kindVocabulary.label: hover
kindVocabulary.about: soft attention — a cue that something is there

kindVocabulary.label: sweep
kindVocabulary.about: a rising or falling move — a build or a drop

kindVocabulary.label: other
kindVocabulary.about: a sound that does not fit one of the named kinds

kindVocabulary.label: tap
kindVocabulary.about: a light tap — a fingertip, a small contact

kindVocabulary.label: note
kindVocabulary.about: a tuned note — a mallet, a pluck, a chime

kindVocabulary.label: swish
kindVocabulary.about: a light move, softer and quicker than a whoosh

kindVocabulary.label: sting
kindVocabulary.about: a brand sting — the sound that signs a thing off

kindVocabulary.label: hit
kindVocabulary.about: a hit that lands on the cut

kindVocabulary.label: knock
kindVocabulary.about: a knock — wood, metal, a door

kindVocabulary.label: shimmer
kindVocabulary.about: a bright, airy texture

kindVocabulary.label: drip
kindVocabulary.about: water, a drop, a leak

kindVocabulary.label: shutter
kindVocabulary.about: a camera shutter, a mechanical snap

kindVocabulary.label: foley
kindVocabulary.about: real-world texture — cloth, paper, a hand

kindVocabulary.label: zap
kindVocabulary.about: electric, a spark, a jump
